Co-taught Course COMP6240

Introduction

Students design, query and reason about relational databases.

Requisite and Incompatibility

To enrol in this course you must have successfully completed COMP1100 or COMP1130. You are not able to enrol in this course if you have successfully completed COMP6240.

Learning Outcomes

  1. Design a normalised relational schema.
  2. Write and evaluate relational queries.

Indicative Assessment

  • Database design assignment (40%) [LO 1]
  • Final examination (60%) [LO 1, 2] - hurdle

Workload

Students should allow 130 hours for this course.

Inherent Requirements

Students must be able to use a computer for extended periods.

Prescribed Texts

No prescribed text.
